summary: SurgePays filed an 8-K reporting a secured note purchase agreement for a $500,000 promissory note with an investor, part of a series of financings led by Belleau Wood Capital totaling $2,650,000. The note matures in 24 months, accrues 14.5% interest, with quarterly principal repayments starting at 12 months, and is convertible into shares at escalating prices from $2.00 to $10.00 per share. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation transaction.
